about: Questions for the search_docs tool, each with the section that answers it (matched by words in the section's heading, in the named document). 'direct' questions use the documents' own words, 'paraphrase' ones don't, 'out_of_scope' ones are not answered by the documents at all and should come back empty. Written by the author of the documents, before the first run, which is a limit on how much the result proves. After the first run, seven questions that are written up in both documents had the second document's section accepted too (the 'alt' lists); no label was changed to turn a wrong answer into a right one.
